result.summary: The home feed is mostly well-formed, but one section header shows a raw, untranslated localization key instead of real text. A few minor styling and accessibility concerns are also present.

issues.description: The section title reads 'home_feed.popular_title', which is an unresolved localization key rather than user-facing copy.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so raw keys never appear in the UI.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' time badge on the first 'Fastest near you' card overlaps the plate image and sits close to it, so it looks slightly misaligned with the badges on the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Keep badge position and padding consistent across cards and avoid overlapping the main food image.

issues.description: Secondary grey text (delivery fees, the 'Search', 'Orders' and 'Profile' tab labels, the search placeholder) has fairly low contrast against light backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the grey text to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the food images uses a dark translucent circle that is inconsistently visible. It nearly disappears on the dark ramen image but stands out on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent solid or higher-contrast background for the favorite button.
